summary: 10.0.34.15 Enterprise Release - 4-Tab Reporting Desktop Parity, Dynamic Business Footer with IST Clock, Match Link Deep Navigation, Purple Action Badges, and Import Audio Guard
highlights: 1. Desktop Parity 4-Tab Reports Studio: Complete rewrite of ReportsController.js and #view-reports providing Dashboard (Tab 1) with 6 KPI cards, recent sales/purchases, payment breakdown and top rankings; Report Center (Tab 2) with category pills, catalog search, star favorites; Saved Reports / Dynamic Report Viewer (Tab 3) with collapsible 3-row filter panel, live REST querying, dynamic grid, and deep-link 'View Source'; and Scheduled Reports (Tab 4) with 4 KPI cards, scheduling table, action dropdown, and Desktop Parity New Schedule modal

2. Dynamic Business Profile Footer & Real-Time IST Clock: Bottom persistent footer dynamically bound to business profile (Company Name, Phone, Email, Website) and real-time live ticking clock formatted as 'Day, DD Mon YYYY | hh:mm:ss A | IST'

3. Bank Statement Match Deep-Linking & Pulsating Highlight: Intelligent document reference resolution across Sales (JI/, INV), Purchases (PR/2026/, PUR), and Recon (PRC) with automated tab navigation, target register filtering, and animated pulsating row highlight (.row-match-highlight)
4. Purple Action Buttons Parity: Replaced secondary action buttons in Bank Statement and Purchase Recon registers with signature purple gradient styling (.btn-purple)

5. Import Audio Call Defensive Guard: Implemented playNotification() in AudioSynthesizer.js and defensively wrapped all audio invocations in ImportController.js with try/catch and function-existence checks, eliminating false import error alerts

6. Purchase Recon Import Dual-Entity Backend Alignment: Dual-transmitted sourceFingerprint/fingerprint and importNote/note in Purchase Recon import payload to satisfy PurchaseReconDtos.ImportRequest and guarantee simultaneous creation of PurchaseReconEntity and ReconSupplierEntity
